argument: The tableau must read as a distributed field of nine irregular apertures around a quiet absence, not a grid or crowd. The three changed bodies must be actual SVG path mutations.

With labels, readout, controls, annotations, and furniture hidden, the first view should break from the route, theatre, and pressure-sheet grammar. After a commit, the attended body, wrong counted body, and echo body must be findable without prose.
Focus and pointer selection may not write. Tab plus Enter, Space, the button, Delete, and R must be real equivalent paths; lift must reconstruct the exact preceding SVG field.
The little-critters relation is translated into a non-figurative error system. No animal, eye, head-turn, paper scene, or reciprocal-looking surface vocabulary may carry the mechanism.

Delete v026 if it is only a polished polygon scatter, if focus commits, if fewer than three bodies change, if the wrong witness is fixed or cosmetic, if later miscounts forget prior geometry, or if the caption is required to see the error.
